evidence.why: Creates the article during Copy Ability loss using ability-loss-star attributes.
Exact sign checks, threshold comparison and unclamped subtraction.

facts.rationale: Canonical caller resolves the article identity, while the helper establishes a pre-update threshold rather than strict saturation.
facts.value: Implements falling for Kirby's Copy Ability loss star using its configured fall acceleration and speed threshold. The shared helper subtracts acceleration when velocity has the same sign as the acceleration argument, or when opposite-sign velocity magnitude is below the threshold. It does not clamp the resulting velocity, so an update can overshoot the nominal maximum fall speed.
